notes.title: Update to playtest and user feedback survey
notes.content:
Hi all, 

We published a tiny update to the playtest demo. This includes a link to a survey where you can provide feedback on the game demo. Also, a brief reminder that controller support is for wireless (bluetooth) xbox controllers and usb connected ps5 controllers (for some reason the library is not listing the correct controller support).

If you are having technical difficulties or would prefer to provide feedback via email, contact us at doctor.mondosoft@gmail.com

Best,
Mondosoft
